og.h1: If the job is still open, tailor the CV and apply on their page.

slides.h1: You may be tailoring a CV for a job that's already closed.
slides.caption: You may be tailoring a CV for a job that's already closed. AB InBev still advertised 69.6% of the India roles its hiring system had closed, through 24 September 2026.

slides.headline: Whether it's still open depends on the employer.
slides.note: Share of closed India roles still advertised, through 24 September 2026.
slides.caption: Whether it's still open depends on the employer: Palo Alto Networks still advertised 50.0% of its closed India roles, Barclays 13.2%.

slides.headline: Closing the role and pulling the ad are two teams' jobs.
slides.text: At most companies one team closes the role in the hiring system. Another pulls the ad from the careers page, and one of them is slower.
slides.caption: Closing the role and pulling the ad are two teams' jobs at most companies, and one of them is slower.

slides.headline: So you can spend an evening on a role that's filled.
slides.text: At AB InBev, a closed role's ad stayed up 11.5 days on average.
slides.caption: So you can spend an evening tailoring a CV for a role that's already filled. At AB InBev, a closed role's ad stayed up 11.5 days on average.

slides.headline: Check the employer's own hiring system before you tailor.
slides.text: Not just the careers page. Open the role where you would apply. If the hiring system no longer has it, the ad is all that's left.
slides.caption: Check the employer's own hiring system before you tailor, not just the careers page.

slides.h1: Still open? Tailor your CV and apply on their page.
slides.sub: Myro tailors it to that one job.
slides.caption: Still open? Tailor your CV to it and apply on the company's own page. Link in bio.
